run_benchmark_wav: run the WAV loading benchmark comparing spdl.io.load_wav, spdl.io.load_audio, and soundfile libraries
create_wav_data: create in-memory WAV audio data with configurable sample rate, channels, bit depth, and duration
load_spdl_wav: load WAV audio data using the fast native spdl.io.load_wav parser
load_spdl_audio: load WAV audio data using the general-purpose spdl.io.load_audio FFmpeg backend
load_sf: load WAV audio data using the soundfile library via io.BytesIO
